canonical.title: Target Sum
canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/4. DP on Subsequences/08. Target Sum.cpp

narrative.title: The Sensor Pairing Dip Switch
narrative.scenario: A calibration rig flips each of n sensor channels into either an amplifying or an attenuating mode before a measurement run. The lab needs the combined gain to land exactly on a target offset, and the technician counts how many switch assignments achieve it. Channels with identical ratings are still independent hardware, so each assignment counts separately.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n non-negative integers and an integer target.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of ways to assign + or - signs so the signed sum equals target.

testCases.explanation: Exactly one channel attenuates (five choices); each gives 4 - 1 = 3.

hintLevels: Level 1: Split the channels into an amplifying set P and an attenuating set N; their sums differ by target.
Level 2: sum(P) - sum(N) = target with sum(P) + sum(N) = total pins sum(P) at (total + target) / 2 — a count-subsets run.
Level 3: Guard the impossible cases first: total + target odd, or |target| > total, both answer 0.
